SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.name = '数码' THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) as digital_sales,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) as total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
    c.name,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) as sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT 
    c.name,
    c.id,
    c.parent_id,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) as sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.parent_id
ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.parent_id = 1 THEN oi.qty * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) as digital_sales,
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) as total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
SELECT (209330.25 * 100.0 / 229474.7) as percentage

SELECT 
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') THEN o.id END) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')

SELECT 
    c.id as category_id,
    c.name as category_name,
    SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) as gross_profit
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1
